summary: Greenland Energy Co filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 reporting that its Board designated Mr. Roderick McIllree as Managing Director for strategic oversight of Greenland operations, effective July 3, 2026. The designation is not an officer appointment, does not create an employment relationship, and involves no salary—only director fees. No financial terms, shares, or deal structure are involved. This is a routine board-level role assignment, not a special situation. No watch items or arb angles apply as there is no acquisition, divestiture, or capital transaction.
